translate_en|mods/ManageContainers/42/me: Add categories using items in the container

<CENTRE> <SIZE:medium> This is the Container Configuration Panel. <LINE> <LINE> <SIZE:small> <LEFT>  Here you can determine which type of item category the container will receive. <LINE> <LINE>  Once you've configured your container, you can select which item to transfer, right click, and select "Put in Assigned Containers".  <LINE> <LINE> Clicking "Transfer All" + Shift will move all valid content in nearby designated containers.
